newsitem.title: USA: Buenaventura rises on mine ruling.
newsitem.headline: Buenaventura rises on mine ruling.

text.p: Peru's Compania de Minas Buenaventura SA rose on Tuesday because of a court ruling that boosted its and Newmont Mining Corp's stakes in Latin America's biggest gold mine, analysts said.
Buenaventura's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose 1-5/8, or almost 11 percent, to 16-3/4. Volume in late afternoon was 188,600 shares, more than seven times normal daily trade.
The Monday ruling by Lima's Superior Court gives Buenaventura and Newmont the right to acquire another 24.7 percent of equity interest in their Yanacocha gold mine for $109 million.
"Frankly this is a good deal because (the stake) is worth multiples of $109 million," said Warwick Jones, a mining analyst at Robert Fleming Securities.
Newmont shares also were up, rising 1-1/8 to 43-7/8 in moderate volume.
